The program is designed to provide a no-fault system that pays workers for employment-related injuries or illnesses without considering the culpability of any one party. The LHWCA is a mandatory program that is administered by the DOL, and it is funded by general revenue. The program provides medical benefits to fully cover the cost of any medical treatment associated with a covered injury or illness, and it also provides disability benefits to partially cover wages lost due to covered injuries or illnesses. The LHWCA also provides benefits to the families of workers who die on the job, including a burial and funeral allowance. The program provides a comprehensive system for providing workers' compensation benefits to covered workers, and it is an essential component of the U.S. workers' compensation system.
